title: Create shared Workforce live-operations design system
goal: Deliver shared Admin primitives for a responsive, accessible, high-density live-operations workforce experience.

in: Live-operations primitives in components/ui/** for the workforce command shell, department health, attention, status, timeline, inspector, and dense collections
Scheduling theme convergence onto shared tokens
A published usage contract the admin lanes compose from
out: Any path under components/admin/** — that is the admin lane's, held by ADMVIEW-001 and claimed by seven WFC admin tasks (CP-101)
app/globals.css or any change to the app-wide --radius token, frozen by CP-100

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Primitives use shared Admin tokens and semantic status colors
There is one main landmark and no nested full-page overflow trap
Primary text is at least 14px and interactive targets at least 44px
Keyboard, focus, contrast, reduced-motion, and breakpoint states are covered
Every primitive ships in components/ui/** with a documented admin usage contract, so no WFC admin lane has to author a shared primitive
No WFC delivery writes a single line under components/admin/**
Radius is consumed as a frozen token: any surface needing a different radius ships a scoped token and does not modify :root (CP-100)
All four source-state presentations (fresh, stale, unavailable, not_authorized) are visually distinct and never render an unavailable source as zero (CP-098)
